title: docs-sync registry
description: The manifest of doc artifacts (pages, screenshots, videos) and the deckyard-core source paths each one depends on. Validated by check-staleness.mjs before any hashing: a malformed registry is a build error, not a drift report.

coreRepo.description: Path to the deckyard core checkout, relative to this repo root.

hash16.description: A 16-hex-character baseline hash, or null when never baselined.

module.description: Path to the core recipe module, relative to this repo root (so it starts with the same ../deckyard prefix as coreRepo).

id.description: Stable kebab-case slug. Uniqueness is enforced by the checker, not by this schema.

path.description: The file on disk this entry is about, relative to this repo root.

docPages.description: The page(s) that surface this artifact. May be empty.

sources.description: Core paths (files or directories) that, when they change, make this artifact stale.

lang.description: Language of the artifact itself (for a screenshot or video: of the recorded UI, not of any overlay text).

capturedAt.description: YYYY-MM-DD the screenshot or video was last recorded.

recipe.description: How the capture factory regenerates this artifact, or null when it is made by hand.

allOf.$comment: A screenshot is a PNG in this repo, produced either by hand or by a recipe, so it always claims a file and a capture date and always answers the recipe question.
A video take is rendered in the private deckyard-video repo and only lands in public/videos/ once the launch video ships, so until then it claims no file on disk.
A doc entry is prose, and prose is not captured and has no capture recipe. It may still name a path: two entries track a generated data file (src/data/*.json) rather than a set of pages.
